objective: Paired offline comparison on the same eight archived Blacktoon banner crops and ordinary controls. Determine whether a frozen multimodal embedding model adds useful review candidates without false positives.
primaryVariant: baseline OR (observed external candidate AND interleaved image+OCR positive-minus-negative cosine margin >= 0.05)
diagnosticVariants: nearest class at margin 0; diagnostic only
decisionRole: Review candidate only. Embedding similarity is not OCR transcription or legal proof and never adds an official concealment finding.
positivePrompts: 온라인 카지노 신규 가입과 첫 입금 보너스를 광고하는 배너
사설 도박 사이트의 첫충, 페이백, 콤프와 롤링 혜택 광고
스포츠 토토 베팅 사이트의 충전과 환전 및 가입코드 홍보
테더와 USDT 입출금을 받는 카지노와 바카라 도박 광고
An online casino advertisement offering first deposit bonuses and cash withdrawals.
A gambling banner advertising cashback, comp rewards and wagering rollover bonuses.
An advertisement inviting people to join a sports betting website with a referral code.
A casino promotion for anonymous cryptocurrency deposits, USDT and payouts.
negativePrompts: 공식 쇼핑몰의 제품 구매 할인, 회원 가입 쿠폰과 무료 배송 광고
정상 온라인 게임의 아이템과 게임 머니 충전 이벤트 광고
불법 도박과 카지노 광고를 신고하고 피해를 예방하라는 공공 교육 안내
도서관 전자책 대출 서비스 안내와 웹사이트의 단순 로고 그림
An ordinary retailer advertisement for phones or home appliances, discounts and purchase benefits.
A legal mobile game promotion for virtual items and in-game currency recharge.
A public information poster warning about gambling harm and reporting illegal casino advertisements.
A library lending service announcement, website logo or ordinary illustration.
scoring: For each embedding take maximum cosine against positive text descriptions minus maximum against negative descriptions. Texts use the official Classification prefix; images do not. No model fitting, prompt tuning or threshold selection on these evaluated images.
split: All eight known positives and original five controls are development regression data, not holdout. Additional ordinary official-retailer advertisements and synthetic hard negatives are frozen before inference and reported separately; this small selected corpus is not population performance.
ablation: Compare identical inputs with text only, image only and interleaved image+OCR. Also compare all-white image replacement and OCR text omission. Repeat frozen inference for paired seeds; report output dispersion and median latency with range.
success: At the predeclared primary margin, at least one additional true review candidate with no extra false positives on either original controls or additional normal advertisements. Otherwise do not claim a useful primary improvement or enable in production.
